title: task-tree dimension
description: Editor aid for dimensions/<name>.json; the file name is the dimension's name. The task-tree compiler is the authority: it also checks that appliesTo names existing tasks, which this schema cannot express.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

appliesTo.description: Ids of the tasks this dimension applies to; each task's subtree is included.

name.description: Non-blank, without leading or trailing whitespace or control characters.
